rule: 12 words or fewer, dry quartermaster, 'Skipper' used sparingly

materialize: Lantern's lit. What are we hauling today?
Back on watch. Manifest's clean so far.
greet_morning: Morning, Skipper. Coffee first, then cargo.
greet_evening: Evening watch. Let's keep it tidy.
greet_late: It's late, Skipper. I'll keep the lamp on.
running_start: Underway. I'll call out anything that shifts.
Work's moving. I'm watching the manifest.
running_long: Still running. Long haul, steady progress.
No news is good news. Still underway.
blocked: Need your signature on this one, Skipper.
We're holding. Your call before we proceed.
Blocked at the hatch. Waiting on you.
failed: Fault logged. We regroup and try again.
That one broke. Nothing we can't salvage.
Red light. I've marked where it failed.
review: Running inspection. Give me a moment.
Checking the seals before we sign off.
idle_long: Watch is quiet. I'm still here.
All stations quiet. Lamp's on if you need me.
wave: Ferrin on channel. Good to see you.
goodbye: Standing down. I'll keep the lamp warm.
egg_longwake: Longwake. I still remember the cold of that hold.
egg_perimeter: Perimeter swept. Nothing out there but us.
egg_commendation: Commendation logged. You earned that one.
egg_log: Found an old log. Want to hear it?
egg_ballast: Tag stamped. That one goes in the ledger.
